reasons.text: This batch removes the last healthy Exchange Online (Plan 2) assignment, carried by group Firm Staff. The mailbox stays shared but goes over its 50 GB quota at 62 GB.
reasons.consequence: Exchange team blog: when the license is removed from a converted shared mailbox over 50 GB, the 50 GB quota is enforced, sending and receiving stop, and incoming mail fails with "Mailbox is full", code 5.2.2.
reasons.remediation: Keep Exchange Online (Plan 2) assigned independently of the group: assign it directly, confirm the assignment is Active, then check again. Or bring the mailbox under 50 GB, then check again.
